messages:
Anna (People Ops): Heads-up: Eli Park turned in notice yesterday, official last day 2026-06-12. We need benefits termination, COBRA mailing, exit interview, and access deprovision. Can folks confirm timelines?
Eli Park: Ill help with transfer notes. My schedule: client demos finish 6/10, knowledge transfer 6/11-6/12.
Julia (HR): We usually run benefits through the last day of the month. We can set employer-covered benefits to end 2026-06-30 and issue COBRA materials 2026-07-01. Any objections?
Eli Park: Thats great, thanks for that.
Anna (People Ops): Sounds good. Eli is US benefits-eligible despite recent travel. We'll plan COBRA effective 2026-07-01.
Mike (IT): Proposed deprovision timeline: SSO revoke on 2026-06-13 morning (next business day), device return by 2026-06-15. Any service accounts/tokens to rotate earlier?
Sam (Eng): Eli still owns redwood-staging-svc account. I can rotate the key but need a 30-min maintenance window to update runners, target 2026-06-14 09:00 PT.
Anna (People Ops): @Sam please book that and loop in @Mike. Adding KMS access handoff to exit checklist.
Mike (IT): Created IT ticket IT-7248 for pickup + deprovision. Will send pre-paid return label if remote. Eli, do you want label or office drop-off?
Eli Park: Remote, please send pre-paid; Ill drop at USPS on 6/13 and message tracking.
Julia (HR): Scheduling exit interview: available slots 6/15 10:00 PT or 6/16 15:00 PT. Which is preferred?
Eli Park: 6/16 15:00 PT works.
Sam (Eng): For repos: Eli, can you list open PRs and high-priority TODOs so I can reassign to Nora?
Eli Park: Open PRs: #412, #415 (needs review), #421 (blocked by infra). TODOs in project board and repo README; will update by 6/11 EOD.
Mike (IT): deprovision-bot: hold placed on account eli.park until 2026-06-13 09:00:00 UTC. After that SSO deprovision will run. Reply with APPROVE <reason> for exceptions.
Anna (People Ops): Payroll note: final pay + unused PTO processed on regular payroll; June payroll cutoff 2026-06-20 so final included 6/30.
Julia (HR): COBRA packet to be sent via email and USPS hard copy on 2026-07-01. Eli, confirm mailing address?
Eli Park: Confirmed address on file.
Sam (Eng): Confirmed rotation 6/14 09:00 PT. Ill post checklist: update service account secret, kick runners, smoke tests.
Mike (IT): IT-7248 updated: label sent (tracking 9400111122223333). Reminder: remove personal MFA devices before deprovision.
Anna (People Ops): Ill update offboarding tracker: last day 2026-06-12; benefits end 2026-06-30; COBRA 2026-07-01; exit interview 2026-06-16 15:00 PT; laptop tracking.
Eli Park: Thanks everyone  Ill finish handoff notes and the access checklist by EOD 6/11.
deprovision-bot: Auto-reminder set for 2026-06-12 16:00:00 UTC to confirm laptop shipped and PR ownership reassigned.
Anna (People Ops): Great, closing once deprovision completes. :heart:
